{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows to understand the structure
display(trial_df.head())

# Show basic info about the data
display(trial_df.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()
display(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()
display(duplicates)

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column
unique_arms = trial_df['arm'].unique()
display(unique_arms)

# Check the unique values in the 'response' column
unique_responses = trial_df['response'].unique()
display(unique_responses)"}
